Pesto
 
Save Print
Author: Amy Simonsen
Recipe type: Dinner
Cuisine: Italian
Ingredients
  • 2 Cup(s) basil - firmly packed
  • ¼ Cup(s) extra virgin olive oil
  • ¼ Cup(s) water
  • ¼ Cup(s) pine nuts - toasted
  • 1 Teaspoon(s) salt
  • ¼ Teaspoon(s) pepper
  • ½ Cup(s) grated parmesan cheese
  • 4 Clove(s) minced garlic (maybe more)
  • 1½ Cup(s) heavy cream (optional)
Instructions
  1. Combine first six ingredients in the blender. Puree everything. Add parmesan cheese and garlic and blend until combined. Taste and add more garlic if necessary.
  2. Optional: Cook 4 chicken breasts in skillet over medium high heat with 2 tbsp evoo, 1 tsp salt, ¼ - ½ tsp pepper, and about 6 cloves of garlic. Remove chicken when done. Deglaze pan with a little cream. Add pesto and 1½ cups cream. Toss with noodles. Top with chicken.
  3. Pesto can be frozen in ice cube trays and used later for a quick meal.
